Name: Guide Financial Closing Activities with an Intelligent Closing Advisor Agent
UCLongDescription:
Financial controllers managing period-end and year-end close in SAP S/4HANA track dozens of interdependent tasks - depreciation runs, foreign currency revaluations, GR/IR clearings, intercompany reconciliations, accruals - manually across multiple apps, carrying dependency chains in memory and addressing blockers only when downstream work stalls.

This prompt builds a Financial Closing Advisor that does that work continuously: it retrieves all task statuses from the SAP Financial Closing Cockpit, classifies each as actionable, blocked, or at-risk, traverses the full dependency graph, and recommends which activities to action next - with explicit reasoning and proactive deadline alerts.

Copy the prompt into Joule Studio and the tooling handles everything - from code generation to a deployed, ready-to-use agent.
